svg.title: Valdara Industries, Serra 180 – Casting method: mould with two frames (VI-DWG-B180-008)
svg.text: PLAN OF THE MOULD, COPE REMOVED: two castings, top risers (circles), sprue, runner, ingates
Two frames per mould (one bench), mirrored; sprue between them,
runner 31 x 26 mm, 186 mm long; one ingate into each main
junction J (20 x 20 mm). Choke (sprue) Ø23 mm.
Pouring 48 kg in about 10 s (t = 1.4√W), head 250 mm.
Risers (modulus method): wall modulus 4.0 mm, junction
6.0 mm, riser ≥ 7.2 mm: Ø34 x 51 mm top risers.
Feeding distance 86 mm each side (SFSA bar rule): 16 risers
per frame (6 at junctions, 10 along members).
Poured 47.7 kg for 25.6 kg of castings: yield 54 %.
Junction risers only: 36.7 kg, yield 70 % (centre-line porosity).
Serra 180 – Casting method: mould with two frames
GE240+N (EN 10293, 1.0446) mass 47.7 kg poured per mould
